Item.display: Close crosses above Highest(High,N)[1] AND startH < Hour < endH
Item.name: DonchianSessionBreakUp
Item.help: Complex breakout: Close breaks the prior N-bar high (confirmed channel, shift 1) only when the bar's hour is inside the session window. Hours are broker server-time — calibrate.

Item.name: Highest
Item.help: Returns highest value of given period of bars

Item.display: Close crosses below Lowest(Low,N)[1] AND startH < Hour < endH
Item.name: DonchianSessionBreakDown
Item.help: Complex breakout (short): Close breaks the prior N-bar low inside the session window. Broker server-time — calibrate.

Item.name: Lowest
Item.help: Returns lowest value of given period of bars

Item.display: Close crosses above prior-day High AND Hour > afterH AND ATR%Rank < ceil
Item.name: PrevDayBreakSqueezeUp
Item.help: Compound: break of the prior-day high, taken only after the open hour and only when volatility is compressed (ATR Percent Rank below the ceiling = a squeeze-then-break). HighD read confirmed (shift 1).

Item.display: Close crosses below prior-day Low AND Hour > afterH AND ATR%Rank < ceil
Item.name: PrevDayBreakSqueezeDown
Item.help: Compound (short): break of the prior-day low after the open hour, out of a compressed-volatility regime.

Item.display: HighestIndex(High,N)[1] = 0 (fresh N-bar high) AND startH < Hour < endH
Item.name: FreshHighSessionUp
Item.help: Compound recency breakout: the most recent confirmed bar set a fresh N-bar HIGH (HighestIndex of High is 0), taken only inside the session window. HighestIndex is an ignoreInBuilder atom — the random builder can't make this.

Item.name: (HI) Highest index
Item.help: returns shift of the bar with highest value from the bars of given type

Item.display: LowestIndex(Low,N)[1] = 0 (fresh N-bar low) AND startH < Hour < endH
Item.name: FreshLowSessionDown
Item.help: Compound recency breakout (short): the most recent confirmed bar set a fresh N-bar LOW inside the session window.

Item.name: (LI) Lowest index
Item.help: returns shift of the bar with lowest value from the bars of given type

Item.display: Close crosses above Highest(High,N)[1] AND BarRange > BiggestRange(M)[1] AND Hour > afterH
Item.name: RangeExpBreakUp
Item.help: Compound: an N-bar high break that is ALSO a volatility-expansion bar (current range exceeds the biggest range of the prior M bars), taken after the early session. Channel and expansion baseline read confirmed (shift 1).

Item.name: Highest
Item.help: Returns highest value of given period of bars

Item.name: Biggest Range
Item.help: returns value of biggest range (high - low of one candle) of candles in given period

Item.display: Close crosses below Lowest(Low,N)[1] AND BarRange > BiggestRange(M)[1] AND Hour > afterH
Item.name: RangeExpBreakDown
Item.help: Compound (short): an N-bar low break that is also a range-expansion bar, taken after the early session.

Item.name: Lowest
Item.help: Returns lowest value of given period of bars

Item.display: Close crosses above Highest(High,N)[1] AND dowLo < DayOfWeek < dowHi
Item.name: MidWeekBreakUp
Item.help: Compound: N-bar high break only on mid-week bars (skips the week-open and week-close days, where breakouts whipsaw). Day numbering is broker-specific (this assumes Mon=1..Fri=5) — calibrate.

Item.name: Highest
Item.help: Returns highest value of given period of bars

Item.display: Close crosses below Lowest(Low,N)[1] AND dowLo < DayOfWeek < dowHi
Item.name: MidWeekBreakDown
Item.help: Compound (short): N-bar low break only on mid-week bars.

Item.name: Lowest
Item.help: Returns lowest value of given period of bars

Item.display: HighestIndex(High,N)[1] > k AND LowestIndex(Low,N)[1] > k AND startH < Hour < endH
Item.name: IntradayCoilArm
Item.help: Compound coil gate (symmetric, non-directional): neither a fresh N-bar high nor a fresh N-bar low printed in the last k bars (both extreme-indices are old) AND inside the session window = an intraday contraction that arms a breakout. Pair with a directional breakout in strategy assembly.
